[需求来源]/[Source of demand]:

8社会议记录：

[Attachment: image-20260818-072216.png | Description: Screenshot of a communication record confirming the vehicle model specification reuse for 004T as Vehicle=HB(232D).]
[详细信息]/[Detail information]：

设计要点：

1.每个模式车模的颜色与设计图相比颜色是否OK（因工程无法百分之百设计效果完全一致，但是颜色需接近，要保证色相的统一，整体画面颜色的协调，车身反射颜色与天空以及山体颜色要在同一色系）

2.车模位置、车模形状、车模倒影要与设计图一致（并且要保证工程中每个模式的车模位置相同，模式与模式切换时不能有抖动）

3.车模以外的部分像是每个模式的背景右文言部分等都无变更（右边侧文言布局分为Toggle Switch、Push Switch）

 以上设计要点只站在设计的角度，针对设计效果上开发与测试上需要关注的点 不能作为开发跟测试只需关注以上评论进行测试跟开发的理由

comments.author: Yuying Xing
comments.body:
测试版本：20260717_Kanzi_Project_Platform_vReleasefor#2-Toyota-1A-DN(745D)

测试结果：NG

PC端动效请动效侧 @Bin Huang  走查

动效云盘路径：/群组文件/RW_Veleda2026/05-Testing/Jira_Attachments/VEL-16616/004T-DMS1.mp4&004T-DMS2.mp4

问题1：首次进入DMS画面时，车模一帧显示，无渐显效果

[Attachment: image-20260818-025221.png | Description: Comparison between the UI reference video (top) and Kanzi implementation (bottom), illustrating that the car model appears in a single frame without a fade-in effect upon entering DMS mode.]
问题2：UI视频中右侧list是在车模进场后出现，工程中list先于车模出现，且渐显效果不一致

[Attachment: image-20260818-053910.png | Description: Comparison showing that the right-side drive mode list appears before the car model in the engineering build (bottom), contradicting the UI reference (top) where the car enters first.]
问题3：UI视频中车模和DMS背景同时显示；工程中车模先显示，背景后显示

[Attachment: image-20260818-053808.png | Description: Comparison showing that in the engineering build (bottom), the car model appears before the DMS background displays, whereas they appear simultaneously in the UI design (top).]
问题4：UI视频中车模渐显的同时左右mid和表盘同步渐隐；工程中左右mid渐隐后表盘才开始渐隐，且渐隐效果与UI不同

[Attachment: image-20260818-054450.png | Description: Comparison demonstrating that the gauge dial fade-out starts only after the left/right mid-displays have faded out in the implementation (bottom), unlike the synchronized fade-out in the UI design (top).]
问题5：工程中车模进场时车轮高亮显示，UI视频为扫光时高亮

问题6：UI视频中，右侧list渐显一段时间后，选项框才开始下移，工程中在list刚开始渐显时，选项框就已经开始下移，与UI的下移时机不符

[Attachment: image-20260818-071907.png | Description: Comparison showing the drive mode selection frame shifting downwards too early during the list fade-in sequence compared to the UI reference timing.]
问题7：UI视频中车模扫光约816毫秒(约49帧)，扫光与车轮高亮同时结束；工程中车模扫光约534毫秒(15帧)，扫光后车轮仍高亮显示

问题8：DMS退场时一帧消去，没有渐隐动效

问题9：UI视频中 左右mid渐显时表盘同步渐显；工程中左右mid完全显示后，表盘才显示

[Attachment: image-20260818-063832.png | Description: Comparison during DMS exit animation where the gauge dials appear only after the mid-displays are fully shown in Kanzi (bottom), rather than fading in simultaneously as designed (top).]
问题10：ECO→表盘→CUSTOM情况下，右侧选项框是从ECO上移到CUSTOM

[Attachment: 20260818160646_rec_-convert.mp4]
CUSTOM→表盘→RANGE情况下，右侧选项框从Drivemode小字上方入场

[Attachment: 20260818161318_rec_-convert.mp4]
问题11：车模扫光颜色与车轮高亮颜色与UI视频不符

[Attachment: image-20260818-070409.png | Description: Comparison highlighting color discrepancies in the light sweep effect and wheel highlights between the UI design (top) and the Kanzi implementation (bottom).]
问题12：UI视频中选项框跟随文字同步移动；工程中选项框位置原地渐显，不跟随文字移动

[Attachment: image-20260818-071133.png | Description: Comparison showing that the drive mode selection frame fades in at a static position in the implementation (bottom) rather than sliding synchronously with the text as shown in the UI video (top).]
问题13：push模式下，UI视频中车模先进场后文言渐显，工程中文言先于车模出现，且渐显效果与UI 不同

[Attachment: image-20260818-073652.png | Description: Comparison in push mode showing that the mode text appears before the car model in Kanzi (bottom), differing from the car-first entry order in the UI reference (top).]
